purpose: Three settings-screen art directions requested after rejecting the instrument-panel design. The owner selected 03-optical; implemented in the interactive local HTML for visual review.

concepts.title: 1. Открытая типографика
concepts.prompt:
Use case: ui-mockup. Create ONE finished, high fidelity 16:9 settings-screen concept for the existing Russian coastal mystery photography game "Маяк". This is a visual art-direction choice, not a website, not a presentation slide. Reference image is the actual approved Unity ocean scene and is the background plate: preserve its sea, islands, horizon and sunset composition. A dark readability overlay is allowed; do not redesign the sea or add scenery. Design the UI over that background. Show the AUDIO settings so the same content can be compared across concepts. Exact Cyrillic text only: "Настройки", "Назад", the three section tabs "Звук", "Изображение", "Управление"; selected tab "Звук". Exactly three setting rows "Общая громкость" with "80%", "Окружение" with "75%", "Эффекты" with "80%"; each has a real, clearly legible slider. Secondary action "Проверить звук". Footer actions "По умолчанию" and "Применить". Do not add other words, fake section numbers, version/build labels, nautical coordinates, logos, icons unrelated to controls, or new settings. All Russian text must be correct and cleanly set. Visual fidelity of a carefully art-directed shipped PC game menu, with consistent typography, exact alignments and believable hit areas. Avoid generic dashboard cards, rounded pills, neon, glowing outlines, glossy knobs, beveled gold controls, stock admin tabs, excessive ornament, blue-purple gradients and fake 3D hardware. The whole screen should be fully visible.
Direction A — OPEN CINEMATIC TYPOGRAPHY. A genuinely spacious, typographic design with no enclosing panel. A large elegant Cyrillic literary serif heading at upper left. Beneath, a generous vertical category navigation on the LEFT THIRD: active "Звук" large, bright, confident; the other two smaller, quiet, with plenty of spacing. No tab button rectangles or icons. The RIGHT TWO THIRDS hold three wide, clearly aligned rows; humanist sans-serif labels, hairline matte ivory slider rails with a thin rectangular cursor, large warm-white numeric values. Use the background darkness and negative space for hierarchy. Place the actions low and unobtrusively; Apply is a typographic action with one crisp line, not a filled block. An asymmetrical composition with impeccable balance and generous margins, warm ivory and quiet grey-green over the actual ocean. It should feel restrained, contemplative, grown-up, not ornate or "fantasy UI".

Direction B — A GRAPHIC SHIP'S LOGBOOK PAGE. This must be visibly different from a transparent game menu. The actual ocean remains visible around a large FLAT warm off-white archival paper sheet occupying the central 75% of the screen. The sheet is rectangular, matte, with extremely subtle paper tooth; no torn edges, drop-shadow collage, leather, brass, rivets, ropes, illustration or realistic desk scene. Horizontal paper-index tabs along the sheet's TOP EDGE contain "Звук", "Изображение", "Управление". The selected tab joins the page; inactive tabs sit slightly lower in cool grey paper. A confident black-ink serif "Настройки", compact ink-black setting labels, elegantly printed slider scales and restrained square black slider marks, three well-spaced rows. Large ink percentage values aligned at the right edge. Printed editorial/book typography, immaculate alignment. The feeling is a modern, functional interpretation of a keeper's paper log, not vintage decoration. Footer actions typeset like unadorned printed commands. Use dark blue ink and faded warm paper only, keeping the ocean exactly as the reference behind it.

Direction C — PRECISE PHOTOGRAPHIC OPTICS. A stark, graphic, camera-viewfinder-inspired composition, entirely digital and flat; no pretend hardware. CENTERED layout, different from a left sidebar or paper notebook. Put "Настройки" large at top center in a sharp Cyrillic sans-serif. Directly below is a broad HORIZONTAL category navigation of three generous text labels; active "Звук" is held by four tiny crop-mark corners, not a pill, underline, filled card or border box. Below, three equal-width horizontal settings bands, freely sitting on the darkened sea. Labels at the left, long segmented exposure-meter style slider tracks in the middle with many fine precise divisions and a small angular cursor, bold clear percentage values at the right. Exact camera-like rhythm and meticulous spacing, cool ivory, charcoal, one muted orange focus accent. A few functional corner registration marks delimit only the controls area without making an enclosing frame. "Назад" unobtrusive upper left. Footer commands aligned with the controls. Refined editorial photography typography, deliberate visual hierarchy, no luxury-game gold, no ornate serif flourishes. Keep large areas of the real ocean visible.
